description: Stock updates (official company events) — What just happened at a public company, from its official SEC filings: recent material events decoded into plain English (earnings released, executive changes, acquisitions, new debt, auditor changes), the latest annual and quarterly reports, the last earnings release date, red flags in the past 12 months, and filing activity including insider transaction forms.
